ResearchProjectDef.label: soul extraction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to find the soul inside a human body, draw it out and bind it as essence. Needs no power to learn: a cult can take souls with an altar and a knife. The machines it unlocks (the soul crucible, the soul generator, the canister rack and the prisoner battery) also need Electricity.

ResearchProjectDef.label: soul weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Drive projectiles with bound soul essence instead of powder. Every shot ends in a small, vicious blast that takes limbs and shakes the soul loose. Unlocks the soul gun family and soul-charged ammunition.
